title: Father as strike breaker in Houston, shot, then becomes a minister
summary: His father moved to Houston as a strike breaker, was shot, was visited in hospital by Cootie, and afterwards turned to preaching.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, what a shame. What did he do then? What happened?
Well, he left Mobile then, I think, and he went to Houston, Texas. Then he was a sort of a strike breaker. When the men would go on strike, he would bring in other men to work.
Oh, I see. Well, wasn't that a little dangerous?
Yeah. It was dangerous. He got shot.
Tell me about it. First of all, was he a
A real big man. A strong man. They wanted to train him to fight Jack Johnson.
Real tall, strong man. Oh, but he wouldn't do that. So after he got shot in Houston --
Yeah. Some kind of way. I wasn't --
I was in New York then.
So I went down there to see him.
What year was that? I mean I'm interested because I just wondered when did you leave New York and go down and see him? Can you remember?
I can't remember the exact year.
I mean, it wasn't when you were with Duke, was it?
And so you went down and saw him. Was he in hospital?
Oh, dear. Was he badly off?
Yeah. But he pulled through that.
Oh. And then what happened? No more strike breaking, I hope.
No. Then he turned in to be a minister.
For goodness sake. When did he find the church?
